title: Peanut Butter Cucumber Salad
description: From Aaron & Claire: Today, let’s make Peanut Butter Cucumber Salad—but not your usual cucumber salad. Crisp cucumbers tossed in a creamy, nutty peanut butter dressing…sounds amazing, right? It’s quick, easy, and super refreshing. Give it a try, and I’m sure it will become your new favorite dish for hot summer days!
ingredients: 2 scallion or green onion (optional as garnish)
directions: Trim off the ends of the cucumbers and cut them into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a mixing bowl.
Thinly slice the green onion (if using).
Make the dressing: In a small container, combine all the dressing ingredients with the minced garlic. Mix until smooth and well combined.
Pour the dressing over the cucumbers, add 1 tablespoon of freshly ground sesame seeds, and gently toss until everything is evenly coated.
Taste and add more salt if needed.
